newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Colombian cement companies start.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Colombian cement companies start.

text.p: -- ING Barings analysts Eugenia Vargas and Hector Castillo said they had started coverage of Colombia's Compania Cementos Argos SA with a rating of buy and of Cementos del Caribe SA with a rating of hold.
-- "We recommend a buy on Cementos Argos given its strong growth potential in revenues and its cost reduction efforts," they wrote in a Jan 20 analysis.

-- On Cementos del Caribe, Castillo and Vargas said, "Despite a slight recovery in the local market, we do not expect meaningful earnings growth since exports account for 60 percent of total volume sales."
